The two assertions that consistently fail without_skill are: (1) TikTok trending sound suggestion, (2) correct structural separators — both are skill-specific formatting requirements
Niche hashtag adherence fails without_skill in eval 1 — baseline Claude defaults to tool-specific tags (#n8n) rather than Rich's approved brand hashtags
